summary: Tested all Term V feature additions (feasibility engine, section min/max limits, student credits rule, weekly timetable, admin Feasibility & Sections pages, Term V import card) + light regression. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_termv_features.py = 13/13 PASS. Frontend smoke on preview URL confirmed every new UI element (Credits card 6/5-6 within-range, Current Courses table cols Course/Section/Area/Schedule/Credits with NO capacity, Timetable grid with Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat rows + Not Timetabled section for CIS, Admin Feasibility 4 summary cards + feasibility-table testid, 49 save-* buttons on Sections with successful save toast 'Limits saved for ACDM A', Term V Consolidated Workbook upload card above CSV tabs, Feasibility sidebar link, admin allowlist code contains secy.academics@iiml.ac.in). Verified totals: 453 students / 39 courses / 49 sections. Verified flag transitions OK/OVER/UNDER after PUT /admin/sections/{id}. Verified student PUT returns 403.
action_items: Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_pgp_portal.py has 7 failures because the Term V import replaced demo course codes STR201/OPS101/MKT101 (KeyError). This is expected per test_credentials.md note but the legacy suite should be either removed or rewritten to use real Term V codes (e.g. FIM/ACDM/ETF with stu_real). Non-blocking; new suite fully covers the surface.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1083 lines — still recommended to split into modules (auth, student, admin, imports, feasibility) for maintainability.
SectionLimits Pydantic model accepts min_capacity > max_capacity without validation — admin could set min=100 max=10. Consider a @validator to enforce min <= max.

Feasibility flag logic returns 'OVER' before checking 'UNDER' (line ~971-974) — if a section has both min>proj AND max<proj (impossible since min<=max should be enforced) the branch is fine but relies on invariant. Tie to the validator above.

import_termv note in UI says 'this replaces all existing master data and clears existing requests' — confirm this destructive behavior is protected (currently only admin auth). Consider a confirmation dialog / dry-run token flow like the CSV preview+commit pattern.

enrich_enrollment returns 'day'/'time_slot' as None or 'Not timetabled' inconsistently — code review shows sections store either the literal 'Not timetabled' string or None; frontend TimetablePage handles both, so OK, but backend should normalize (always 'Not timetabled' + '—').

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new tests) + regression: 15/22 legacy pass (7 known-obsolete demo-course tests)

seed_data_creation: Test set min/max on 3 sections during feasibility flag-transition test and reset all to null in same test. ACDM A limits set via UI smoke (10/60) then reset to null via API post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new suite: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_termv_features.py -v -n 0`. All Term V feature endpoints work. Real student data = 453/39/49 (PGP41071 has 7 courses 6.0 credits). Section limits start null → NO_LIMIT flag. Frontend elements have testids: timetable-grid, feasibility-table, save-<section_id>, termv-file-input. Legacy test_pgp_portal.py needs rewrite to use Term V course codes (FIM, ACDM, ETF...) — not blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in the new features.
